title: ZXTank Privacy Information

sections.heading: Privacy Information During Development
paragraphs: ZXTank is not currently available on the App Store. This page records only the development-stage information that has been checked against the project source.
The final product privacy disclosure, including any App Store privacy labels, will be published after production configuration and release behaviour have been verified.

sections.heading: Apple Services and Local Settings
paragraphs: The current project includes Apple Game Center integration and an iCloud key-value-store entitlement for shared settings. Their release behaviour and data handling remain subject to final verification.
The app also stores local settings on the device. No claim is made here about a final account, cloud-save or purchase experience.

sections.heading: Development Integrations
paragraphs: The project contains development configuration for Firebase and shared advertising services. The checked Firebase configuration has analytics disabled, and no runtime collection or advertising delivery has been verified for a released ZXTank build.

If advertising, consent, tracking permission, remote configuration, diagnostics or purchases are enabled for release, this page will be updated with the verified services, purposes and controls before public availability.

sections.heading: Questions About Privacy
paragraphs: For general privacy information, read the [BarkinMad Studios Privacy Policy](/privacy).
For a ZXTank privacy question, contact BarkinMad Studios through the [contact page](/contact).
